properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Web3 Secret Storage (keystore v3) wallet encryption: AES-128-CTR encrypts the private key under a key derived by scrypt (default N=131072) or PBKDF2, with a keccak256 MAC over the ciphertext. The "aes-128-ctr" suite is mandated by the keystore v3 format every Ethereum client reads, so it is not changeable unilaterally. AES-128 leaves ~64-bit security under Grover — below CNSA 2.0's 256-bit bar but not practically attackable. CTR is unauthenticated; integrity rests on the separately-computed kecc
